authorization.scope: User-authorized complete existing-content repair programme. Routine editorial changes need no new human sign-off; this is not financial-review attestation.

authority.requiredCheck: Type, content, security, build and route checks

forbidden: substantive high-risk financial edits without genuine review
changes to routing, redirects, code, policy or registry
undeclared changes or stale content hashes
merge after failed, missing or stale gates
